name: braincloud
description: Ask a question, share a link, and watch everyone's answers grow into a live word cloud

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "cross-env PORT=8000 npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
